svg.title: From an alert to incident response
svg.desc: Bulk downloading does not prove compromise. This is an instructional reading order: preservation, containment and investigation may overlap or repeat. Do not delay necessary action while waiting for perfect evidence. Event / Alert: A system records bulk downloads and issues a notification. Separate observations from hypotheses. Triage: Check identity and permissions, time and origin, data content, business approval, and the completeness and time consistency of original logs. Evidence-based decision: Authorized and reasonable: record why. Insufficient evidence: preserve records and investigate. Suspected or confirmed incident: activate the appropriate response procedure. Preserve evidence and contain: Preserve records and limit harm under procedure; do not automatically power off or delete files. Consider service and patient safety. Eradicate and recover: Address confirmed causes and affected components; verify that services are trustworthy and available. Improve and meet parallel obligations: Fix process gaps and update controls. Assess notification duties, compliance and service impact in parallel.

g.text: From an alert to incident response
Bulk downloading does not prove compromise. This is an
instructional reading order: preservation, containment and
investigation may overlap or repeat. Do not delay necessary action
while waiting for perfect evidence.
1. Event / Alert
A system records bulk downloads and issues a notification. Separate
observations from hypotheses.
2. Triage
Check identity and permissions, time and origin, data content,
business approval, and the completeness and time consistency of
original logs.
3. Evidence-based decision
Authorized and reasonable: record why. Insufficient evidence:
preserve records and investigate. Suspected or confirmed incident:
activate the appropriate response procedure.
4. Preserve evidence and contain
Preserve records and limit harm under procedure; do not
automatically power off or delete files. Consider service and
patient safety.
5. Eradicate and recover
Address confirmed causes and affected components; verify that
services are trustworthy and available.
6. Improve and meet parallel obligations
Fix process gaps and update controls. Assess notification duties,
compliance and service impact in parallel.
